issues.title: Edit orders form lost on table update
issues.body:
Oh no, the dreaded "losing forms" issue is back.

_Maybe_ it's related to updating the material table.

Steps to reproduce:
- game is in `planning` phase
- login as `mtg 1` in one tab
- switch to `orders` tab. Click `person` icon to filter for own orders
- expand a set of orders
- click on `Edit`
- make a change to a line - add some text
- switch to other tab
- login as `mtg 2` in another tab
- switch to `orders` tab. Click activity button, select `Maritime`> `Transit`
- click a few points, then finish the line. An empty form will open. Type in a title, and press `Send`
- the form for `Mtg 1` will now be left in an inconsistent state. The data changes are lost, and it goes back to read-only mode. But, clicking on `Edit` doesn't make form editable, only a page-refresh will fix the page
